digest.component_or_area: CI linting / store write seam enforcement
propositions: Production bypasses of canonical store write seams occurred via raw git add/commit/rm in maintenance commands and workflow YAML, bypassing the locked transaction/append/reconciler APIs.

A deterministic two-layer CI lint (Layer P: Python AST scanning for raw subprocess git mutations and wrapper-name calls with mutation verbs; Layer W: workflow/shell cwd-aware scanner for tracker-context git mutations) must flag all unmarked raw git writes module-agnostically, fail-closed on opaque argv.

All flagged raw git writes at head must be remediated or sanctioned with an inline mandatory-reason marker (# raw-git-ok: <reason>) on seam internals (gitutil, event_append, txn, purge_bridge, git_adapter, _ref_lock), maintenance-command callers, and disposable-workspace sites.

The teaching error message must direct authors to the store write APIs (event_append, transaction, reconciler git_adapter) rather than raw subprocess or run_git_write alone, since run_git_write only self-heals index.lock faults and does not provide the unified lock.
Report-mode bootstrap must enumerate the authoritative hit inventory before enforcement is wired, with every hit remediated or reasoned-marked in the same change.

Accepted residual: argv construction crossing function boundaries or computed dynamically remains undetectable; the lint deterministically catches literal, local-variable/splat, and opaque-forwarding shapes covering all historical bypasses and codebase write idioms.
